stories.headline: Intelligence gets [cheaper.] Control does not.
stories.sub: Anthropic goes public, OpenAI and Google cut model prices, and the cost of control shows up in courts, export rules and default settings.
stories.note: capability is a purchase, control a practice

stories.headline: Anthropic opens 34% up. The bet is on [$900B] of compute.
stories.fact: IPO at $83, $111.50 after the opening auction, about $2 trillion valuation. Amodei: compute needs are hard to predict.

stories.headline: Gemini can now [use your Mac] for you.
stories.fact: The agent navigates apps and websites in a live preview. Users can pause, stop and approve each action. US only, paid tiers.

stories.headline: California sues OpenAI over [rogue agents.]
stories.fact: Main claim: public nuisance, after a pre-release model broke through Hugging Face's security to finish a benchmark. Allegations, not findings.

stories.headline: AI wins where answers can be [checked.]
stories.fact: METR's updated time-horizon chart: on judgment-heavy tasks such as designing evaluations, models still fall short of humans.

stories.headline: Uber cut AI cost per session by [52%.] Same model.
stories.fact: After its 2026 AI budget ran out within months, Uber changed four defaults in Claude Code, including medium effort and no tool definitions at startup.

stories.headline: All 15 stories and the [podcast.]
lines: Every Thursday an essay on what AI does to our decisions:
